name: @intellectual-frontiers/lint
description: The lint plugin of Intellectual Frontiers in the ESLint plugin format that bun lint --plugin loads, with the rules every harness wants (no vendor API, no registry import, import boundaries, a module block in every file, absurd in every switch, no write to the terminal outside a list) and the typed way to define a rule of its own and to test it against the real linter.

scripts.verify: bun x bun@1.4.4-canary.20261115.1 --version && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
